goal_definition: Compare G-E, G-M and G-B; completeness is not evidence of improvement or significance.

metric_contract.micro_diagnostics: flattened label-position threshold-grid Fmax and micro-AUPRC; not a substitute for Stage-1 evalperf_torch in the primary comparison
metric_contract.confidence_interval_scope: paired protein bootstrap is reported only for histogram micro diagnostics; it is not presented as an evalperf_torch CI

checkpoint_selection: ind_test is descriptive, never an early-stop or hyperparameter-selection set

definitions.score_unit: percent; thresholds remain in probability units
definitions.protein_fmax: Harmonic mean of mean per-protein precision and mean per-protein recall, maximized on the stated uniform [0,1] grid; strict >. Exclude empty-gold proteins from both means; precision includes only eligible proteins with predictions, recall includes all eligible proteins. Earliest threshold wins an exact F tie.
definitions.micro_ap: Exact non-interpolated AP over all protein-GO pairs; equal scores grouped.
definitions.micro_pr_auc: Exact trapezoidal area over the empirical micro PR curve, including the precision=1, recall=0 endpoint; equal scores grouped.
definitions.micro_fmax_exact: Best micro F1 among complete equal-score groups. Strict > threshold is next representable score below the minimum included score; can be negative when zero-score pairs are included.
definitions.no_positive_labels: All standardized scores are defined as zero if no positive gold exists.
definitions.task_columns: All supplied columns; no zero-positive-class filtering or ontology propagation.
definitions.legacy_fields: Historical Stage-1 metric fields are preserved and are not overwritten.

standardized_metric_contract.legacy_policy: Historical primary fields remain unchanged; they are not standardized protein-centric Fmax or exact PR-AUC.

legacy_metric_contract.micro_diagnostics: flattened label-position threshold-grid Fmax and micro-AUPRC; not a substitute for Stage-1 evalperf_torch in the primary comparison
legacy_metric_contract.confidence_interval_scope: paired protein bootstrap is reported only for histogram micro diagnostics; it is not presented as an evalperf_torch CI

standardized_goal_definition: Prospectively compare protein-centric Fmax and exact micro PR-AUC against Expert; report exact micro AP separately. Completeness does not imply improvement or statistical significance.

semantics.expert_prob: Stage-1 external_only, source quantized float16 then converted to float32
semantics.decoder_topk: restored from Stage-1 checkpoint/model_args; not NBS candidate_topk
semantics.historical_diagnostic_store_dtype: float16 by default; modelout output quantization may differ
